project_type: Flutter web/mobile app + Supabase backend (Postgres, Auth, RLS)
build_system: Flutter SDK; no workspace tooling. Run flutter commands from the app/ subdirectory.
test_framework: flutter_test is present but no tests exist yet. Verification = successful web build.
verification_instructions: Run `cd /Users/kangjin/Documents/group-planner/app && flutter build web --no-version-check`. A zero exit code with no compilation errors confirms success. Do NOT run `flutter run` without the --web-port flag.
environment_constraints: Port 3000 is used by the running dev server; never bind to it in scripts. Xcode 14.2 is too old for iOS/macOS builds; target web only. The app currently runs via: flutter run -d web-server --web-hostname 127.0.0.1 --web-port 3000 --no-version-check
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow the conventions already present in the codebase exactly.
key_patterns: 1) Repository: plain Dart class, Supabase calls via `_db` helper, wrapped by a Riverpod `Provider`; async reads use `FutureProvider` or `FutureProvider.family`; `friendlyError()` translates DB errors to human strings. 2) UI: `ConsumerWidget` (never StatefulWidget for state) with `ref.watch(someProvider)`; `AsyncBody<T>` for all async data; `ref.invalidate()` for refresh after mutations. 3) All user interactions (text input, confirm, errors) go through dialogs.dart helpers: `promptText`, `confirm`, `showError`, `showMessage`. 4) Sheets: `showModalBottomSheet(isScrollControlled: true, showDragHandle: true, builder: ...)`. 5) Material 3 buttons: FilledButton (primary), FilledButton.tonal (secondary), OutlinedButton, TextButton. 6) Empty states: `EmptyState(icon: ..., message: ...)` from async_body.dart. 7) Characters extension used for `.characters.first.toUpperCase()` on display names.
directory_structure: app/lib/data/ — models.dart + repository files; app/lib/features/{auth,groups,home}/ — feature pages; app/lib/widgets/ — AsyncBody, dialogs; app/lib/router.dart — GoRouter config; app/lib/main.dart — app entry; supabase/migrations/ — DB schema and RLS

db_schema_notes.activities: id (uuid), owner_id (uuid FK profiles), name (text), description (text?), location (text?), price_min, price_max, currency, url, created_at, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at. NO default_activity_type_id column.
db_schema_notes.group_activities: PK is (group_id, activity_id). Columns: group_id, activity_id, type_id (FK to activity_types with composite FK including group_id), added_by (FK profiles), added_at. No UUID id column.
db_schema_notes.activity_types: id (uuid), group_id (uuid FK groups), name (text). Unique index on (group_id, lower(name)).
db_schema_notes.delete_activity_rpc: Security-definer RPC `delete_activity(p_activity uuid)`: checks caller is owner, deletes from group_activities (triggering revert_entries_to_events trigger), then sets deleted_at. Use this instead of direct UPDATE.
